_meta.note: Coverage ratchet floor for `npm run test:coverage` (wired into vitest's coverage.thresholds by vite.config.ts). These are the percentages the committed suite already achieves, rounded down; a change that drops below any of them fails the run. Raise them with `npm run coverage:baseline` after adding tests. Lowering requires `node scripts/coverage-baseline.mjs --allow-decrease`, which is deliberate: coverage is meant to ratchet up, never silently regress.
